meta.name: saga-orchestration
meta.description: Implement saga patterns for distributed transactions and cross-aggregate workflows. Use this skill when implementing distributed transactions across microservices where 2PC is unavailable, designing compensating actions for failed order workflows that span inventory, payment, and shipping services, building event-driven saga coordinators for travel booking systems that must roll back hotel, flight, and car rental reservations atomically, or debugging stuck saga states in production where compensation steps never complete.

copy.tagline: 让跨系统操作在失败时自动撤销
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的操作牵动多个系统,一步失败就要全部回退。
copy.tagline_en: Roll back failed steps across multiple systems to keep data consistent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your operation spans multiple systems and needs full rollback when any part fails

howto.what: Claude会根据你给出的业务步骤，拆解成带顺序和“失败就撤销”补偿的Saga方案，产出协调或事件驱动的实现代码、每步超时设置，以及监控卡住任务的方案。
howto.when: 当你要跨多个服务协调需要回滚的多步交易，而两阶段提交不可用时，比如订单涉及库存、支付、物流的失败补偿，或排查线上卡死的补偿流程。

say.text: 帮我为跨库存、支付、物流的订单流程设计Saga，并为每一步写补偿命令。
say.note: 得到有序步骤与每步撤销逻辑。

say.text: 用编排模式实现这个Saga，带每步超时和卡住检测。
say.note: 生成协调器代码、超时和监控设置。

say.text: 用事件协作模式做旅行预订Saga，失败时逆序取消酒店、航班和租车。
say.note: 得到事件驱动的逆序回滚链。

howto.what_en: Given the business steps, Claude breaks them into an ordered saga with compensating rollback commands, and produces an orchestrator or event-driven implementation, per-step timeouts, and monitoring for stuck tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when coordinating multi-service transactions that need rollback where 2PC is unavailable, such as order flows across inventory/payment/shipping, or debugging stuck compensation flows.

say_en.text: Design a Saga across inventory, payment, shipping with per-step compensation.
say_en.note: Returns ordered steps and rollback logic.

say_en.text: Implement an orchestrator Saga with per-step timeouts and stuck detection.
say_en.note: Gives coordinator code, timeouts, and monitoring.

say_en.text: Create a choreography Saga with reverse-order rollback for hotel, flight, car.
